title: Verify delivery fee is consistent across different orders
gherkin:
Feature: Delivery Fee Billing Consistency
  Scenario: Consistent delivery fee for multiple orders
    Given a customer places an order with a delivery fee of $5
    When the customer places another order
    Then the delivery fee should also be $5
rationale: To ensure that the delivery fee remains the same for multiple orders from the same customer, confirming consistency in billing.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases to ensure consistency in delivery fee billing as per the specified requirement.
